lesson.title: 证明恒等式

en.title: Proving Identities
en.description: Verify, prove, and disprove trigonometric identities while preserving the common domain.

lesson.description: 区分验证、证明与反例，并在三角恒等式的每次变形中保留共同定义域。

concepts.title: 验证、证明与共同定义域
concepts.summary: 恒等式必须对两个原式都有定义的所有值成立。图形或数值可以提供证据，单个反例可以否定恒等式；证明必须给出对任意允许值有效的论证。

method.title: 确定允许值
method.body: 先检查原式中的分母、$\tan,\cot,\sec,\csc$ 和根式，求共同定义域。约分后仍保留原限制。

method.title: 证明任意值
method.body: 分别化简左、右两边，直到得到相同表达式；也可只把一边变为另一边。不要把待证等式当成已知方程跨等号运算。

pitfalls: 未定义的角不是一个可用反例；反例必须使原式两边都有定义。
图像像素可能掩盖孤立的小孔。

en.title: Verification, proof, and the common domain
en.summary: An identity holds for every value where both original expressions are defined. Graphs and values provide evidence; one counterexample disproves an identity. A proof must work for an arbitrary permissible input.

method.title: Identify permissible values
method.body: Inspect original denominators, $\tan,\cot,\sec,\csc$, and radicals to find the common domain. Keep original restrictions after cancellation.

method.title: Prove for an arbitrary value
method.body: Simplify the sides independently to a common expression, or transform one side into the other. Do not assume the proposed equality and perform operations across its equal sign.

pitfalls: An undefined input is not a valid counterexample; both original sides must be defined.
Graph pixels may conceal isolated holes.

concepts.title: 转为正弦余弦与通分
concepts.summary: $\tan x=\sin x/\cos x$、$\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$、$\sec x=1/\cos x$、$\csc x=1/\sin x$。结合 $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$ 常可把复杂式化为一个基本函数。

method.title: 转换
method.body: 把倒数、商函数写成正弦余弦，并为每个原分母保留非零条件。

method.title: 通分与化简
method.body: 求共同分母合并分式，使用勾股恒等式，再因式分解和约去允许约去的因子。

pitfalls: 只能约去乘法因子，不能约去和式中的一项。

en.title: Rewrite in sine and cosine; combine fractions
en.summary: Use $\tan x=\sin x/\cos x$, $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$, $\sec x=1/\cos x$, and $\csc x=1/\sin x$. Together with $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$, these often reduce complicated expressions to a primary function.

method.title: Rewrite
method.body: Rewrite reciprocal and quotient functions using sine and cosine, retaining every original nonzero-denominator condition.

method.title: Combine and simplify
method.body: Combine fractions over a common denominator, apply the Pythagorean identity, then factor and cancel only nonzero factors.

pitfalls: Cancel multiplicative factors, not terms within a sum.

concepts.title: 选择和角、差角与倍角形式
concepts.summary: $\sin2x=2\sin x\cos x$；$\cos2x=1-2\sin^2x=2\cos^2x-1=\cos^2x-\sin^2x$。选择能与其余项统一变量或产生因子的形式。和差角公式也可证明余函数与乘积恒等式。

method.title: 选择形式
method.body: 看其余项含 $\sin x$ 还是 $\cos x$，选择相同变量的倍角式。

method.title: 保留限制
method.body: 代入、因式分解，并检查倍角分母的全部零点，不能只看最终的 $\tan x$ 或 $\cot x$ 的定义域。

pitfalls: 角度制的 $90^\circ$ 与弧度制的 $\pi/2$ 不可混用。

en.title: Choose sum, difference, and double-angle forms
en.summary: $\sin2x=2\sin x\cos x$ and $\cos2x=1-2\sin^2x=2\cos^2x-1=\cos^2x-\sin^2x$. Choose the form that matches the remaining terms or reveals factors. Sum and difference formulas also prove cofunction and product identities.

method.title: Choose a form
method.body: Inspect whether the other terms use $\sin x$ or $\cos x$, and choose a matching double-angle form.

method.title: Retain restrictions
method.body: Substitute and factor; check all zeros of the original double-angle denominator, not only the domain of the final $\tan x$ or $\cot x$.

pitfalls: Do not mix $90^\circ$ in degrees with $\pi/2$ in radians.

concepts.title: 因式分解与共轭式
concepts.summary: 把 $\sin x$ 或 $\cos x$ 暂当代数变量，可使用提公因子、平方差和二次式分解。乘以共轭式可利用 $(1-\cos x)(1+\cos x)=\sin^2x$。

method.title: 分解
method.body: 先分解原分母得到全部限制，再分解分子，寻找真正的共同乘法因子。

method.title: 共轭与约分
method.body: 需要时分子分母同乘共轭式；确认所乘比值的分母非零。约分后写出共同定义域。

pitfalls: 消失的因子仍可能对应原式不允许值。

en.title: Factoring and conjugates
en.summary: Treat $\sin x$ or $\cos x$ as an algebraic variable to factor common factors, differences of squares, and quadratics. Conjugates use relations such as $(1-\cos x)(1+\cos x)=\sin^2x$.

method.title: Factor
method.body: Factor original denominators to identify all restrictions, then factor numerators and locate common multiplicative factors.

method.title: Conjugate and cancel
method.body: When useful, multiply numerator and denominator by a conjugate, checking that the added denominator is nonzero. State the common domain after cancellation.

pitfalls: A cancelled factor can still correspond to excluded inputs of the original expression.

concepts.title: 应用中的单位、物理范围与平方根
concepts.summary: 代数恒等式的应用还要满足情境条件。飞行距离须保持速度、重力和角度单位；透镜题中 $\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta}=|\cos\theta|$，须由物理角度保证余弦非负。

method.title: 建立条件
method.body: 先列变量意义、单位和物理区间，再代入或替换。折射题还需实根式与非零分母。

method.title: 核对结果
method.body: 用恒等式改写后核对条件和单位；近似计算写 $\approx$，保留足够中间精度。

en.title: Units, physical ranges, and square roots in applications
en.summary: Applications must satisfy contextual conditions as well as algebraic identities. Preserve velocity, gravity, and angle units in flight models. For lenses, $\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta}=|\cos\theta|$; the physical angle range must justify a nonnegative cosine.

method.title: State conditions
method.body: State variable meanings, units, and physical ranges before substituting. Refraction also requires real radicals and nonzero denominators.

method.title: Check the result
method.body: After applying identities, recheck conditions and units. Use $\approx$ for numerical approximations and retain sufficient intermediate precision.

questions.prompt: 模型火箭以仰角 $\theta$ 发射。Katie 得到 $d=\frac{(v_0)^2\sin2\theta}{g}$，Sergey 得到 $d=\frac{2(v_0)^2}{g}(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)$。两式是否等价？用图形和数值方法说明。先代入 $v_0=14\text{ m/s}$、$g=9.8\text{ m/s}^2$ 并化简。

steps.title: 代入
steps.body: $14^2/9.8=20$，故两式分别为 $d_1=20\sin2\theta$ 与 $d_2=40(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)$。

steps.title: 数值比较
steps.body: 角度制取 $\theta=0^\circ,30^\circ,45^\circ,60^\circ$，两式均依次给出 $0,10\sqrt3,20,10\sqrt3$ 米。第一式在 $90^\circ$ 有定义，第二式的 $\tan90^\circ$ 无定义。

steps.title: 图形证据
steps.body: 在 $0^\circ\leq\theta<90^\circ$ 作两图，曲线重合且在 $45^\circ$ 达 $20$ 米。图形与数值支持两式在共同定义域 $\cos\theta\ne0$ 上等价；一般性证明见调查 3。

questions.answer: 在 $\cos\theta\ne0$ 上等价；物理发射角通常取 $0^\circ\leq\theta<90^\circ$。

en.prompt: A model rocket is launched at angle of elevation $\theta$. Katie models its horizontal distance by $d=\frac{(v_0)^2\sin2\theta}{g}$; Sergey uses $d=\frac{2(v_0)^2}{g}(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)$. Are these expressions equivalent? Use graphical and numerical methods. First substitute $v_0=14\text{ m/s}$ and $g=9.8\text{ m/s}^2$ and simplify.

steps.title: Substitute
steps.body: $14^2/9.8=20$, giving $d_1=20\sin2\theta$ and $d_2=40(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)$.

steps.title: Compare values
steps.body: In degrees, at $\theta=0^\circ,30^\circ,45^\circ,60^\circ$, both give $0,10\sqrt3,20,10\sqrt3$ metres, respectively. The first is defined at $90^\circ$, but the second contains undefined $\tan90^\circ$.

steps.title: Graphical evidence
steps.body: Plotting for $0^\circ\leq\theta<90^\circ$ gives overlapping curves with maximum $20$ metres at $45^\circ$. These checks support equivalence on the common domain $\cos\theta\ne0$; Investigate 3 provides a proof.

en.answer: Equivalent on $\cos\theta\ne0$; the usual physical launch interval is $0^\circ\leq\theta<90^\circ$.
en.label: Investigate 1

questions.label: 调查 1

questions.prompt: 两个火箭距离公式中哪些部分相同？

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 两式都给出水平距离 $d$，且共有因子 $\frac{(v_0)^2}{g}$。把它提出，得到 $d=\frac{(v_0)^2}{g}\,[\sin2\theta]$ 与 $d=\frac{(v_0)^2}{g}\,[2(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)]$。

en.prompt: Which parts are common to both rocket-distance formulas?

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: Both model the horizontal distance $d$ and contain $\frac{(v_0)^2}{g}$. Factoring this out gives $d=\frac{(v_0)^2}{g}\,[\sin2\theta]$ and $d=\frac{(v_0)^2}{g}\,[2(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)]$.

en.answer: The common factor is $\frac{(v_0)^2}{g}$.
en.label: Investigate 2

questions.label: 调查 2

questions.prompt: 用两个火箭公式不相同的部分写一个恒等式，并用已学恒等式证明两边等价。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 要证 $\sin2\theta=2(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)$；原式要求 $\cos\theta\ne0$。左边 $\sin2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 右边 $=2\tan\theta(1-\sin^2\theta)=2\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\cos^2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$。两边分别得到同一式，证明成立。

en.prompt: Write an identity using the parts of the rocket formulas that are not common. Rewrite each side using known identities to show equivalence.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: The proposed identity is $\sin2\theta=2(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)$, with $\cos\theta\ne0$. The left side is $2\sin\theta\cos\theta$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: The right side is $2\tan\theta(1-\sin^2\theta)=2\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}\cos^2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$. Both sides independently reduce to the same expression.

en.answer: $\sin2\theta=2(\tan\theta-\tan\theta\sin^2\theta)$，$\cos\theta\ne0$。
en.label: Investigate 3

questions.label: 调查 3

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 可核对的讨论示例：一位先把右边因式分解成 $2\tan\theta(1-\sin^2\theta)$；另一位先写成 $2\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}-2\frac{\sin^3\theta}{\cos\theta}$。第二条路径通分后也是 $2\sin\theta(1-\sin^2\theta)/\cos\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 比较每一步所用恒等式与 $\cos\theta\ne0$ 限制。这是供真实讨论使用的示例，不代表已收集同学的回答。

questions.answer: 两种合法变形都得到 $2\sin\theta\cos\theta$；讨论时保留共同定义域。

en.prompt: Compare your reasoning with that of a classmate.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: A checkable discussion example: one student factors the right side as $2\tan\theta(1-\sin^2\theta)$; another first writes $2\frac{\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}-2\frac{\sin^3\theta}{\cos\theta}$. Combining the latter gives $2\sin\theta(1-\sin^2\theta)/\cos\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: Compare the identity used at each step and the restriction $\cos\theta\ne0$. This is a model for an actual discussion, not a report of collected classmate responses.

en.answer: Both valid routes give $2\sin\theta\cos\theta$; retain the common domain in the discussion.
en.label: Investigate 4

questions.label: 调查 4

questions.prompt: 代数方法与图形或数值验证相比如何？为什么数值和图形验证不能证明一个恒等式？

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 数值检验只检验有限个输入；绘图只有有限分辨率，还可能隐藏未定义点。因此“检验过的值都相等”不能推出“所有允许值都相等”。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 合法的代数变形把任意共同定义域内的 $x$ 化成同一表达式，因而覆盖所有允许值。一个反例足以否定恒等式，但任意有限次成功检验都不能替代一般证明。

questions.answer: 代数证明覆盖所有允许值；有限数值或像素图只提供证据。

en.prompt: How does the algebraic method compare with graphical or numerical verification? Why do numerical and graphical checks fail to prove an identity?

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: A numerical check covers finitely many inputs. A plotted graph has finite resolution and may hide undefined points. Agreement at checked inputs does not establish agreement at every permissible input.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: Valid algebraic transformations reduce both sides to the same expression for an arbitrary input in the common domain, covering every permissible input. One counterexample disproves an identity, whereas finitely many successful checks do not replace a general proof.

en.answer: An algebraic proof covers all permissible values; finite tables or pixel plots provide evidence only.
en.label: Reflect and Respond 5

questions.label: 反思与回应 5

questions.prompt: (a) 用若干 $x$ 值验证 $1-\sin^2x=\sin x\cos x\cot x$，求不允许值，使用角度制。(b) 证明该式对所有允许值成立。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: (a) $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$ 要求 $\sin x\ne0$，即 $x\ne180^\circ n$，$n\in\mathbb Z$。取 $30^\circ$，左边 $1-(1/2)^2=3/4$；右边 $(1/2)(\sqrt3/2)(\sqrt3)=3/4$。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 在 $-360^\circ\leq x\leq360^\circ$ 作图，两条曲线在共同定义域重合。右边在每个 $180^\circ n$ 处缺点，绘图像素可能看不出这些小孔。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: (b) 左边由 $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$ 得 $1-\sin^2x=\cos^2x$。右边 $\sin x\cos x\cot x=\sin x\cos x(\cos x/\sin x)=\cos^2x$，约去的 $\sin x$ 在共同定义域内非零。

en.prompt: (a) Verify $1-\sin^2x=\sin x\cos x\cot x$ for some values of $x$. Determine the non-permissible values; work in degrees. (b) Prove the identity for all permissible values.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (a) Since $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$, require $\sin x\ne0$, so $x\ne180^\circ n$, $n\in\mathbb Z$. At $30^\circ$, the left side is $1-(1/2)^2=3/4$, and the right side is $(1/2)(\sqrt3/2)(\sqrt3)=3/4$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: On $-360^\circ\leq x\leq360^\circ$, the curves coincide on their common domain. The right side has holes at $180^\circ n$, which graph pixels may conceal.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (b) By $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$, the left side is $\cos^2x$. The right side is $\sin x\cos x(\cos x/\sin x)=\cos^2x$; the cancelled $\sin x$ is nonzero on the common domain.

en.answer: The identity holds for $x\ne180^\circ n$, $n\in\mathbb Z$.
en.label: Example 1

questions.label: 例题 1

questions.prompt: 为什么图中看不出不允许值？

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: $\sin x\cos x\cot x$ 在 $\sin x\ne0$ 时等于 $\cos^2x$，但在 $x=180^\circ n$ 无定义。这些只是孤立的小孔；计算器连线与有限像素可将它们遮住，因此图像相似不能说明定义域相同。

questions.answer: 孤立的小孔可能被像素与连线隐藏。

en.prompt: Why are the non-permissible values not apparent from these graphs?

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: $\sin x\cos x\cot x$ equals $\cos^2x$ when $\sin x\ne0$, but is undefined at $x=180^\circ n$. These are isolated holes; connecting segments and finite pixels can conceal them. Similar-looking plots do not imply identical domains.

en.answer: Isolated holes may be hidden by pixels and connecting lines.
en.label: Example 1 sidebar: undefined points

questions.label: 例题 1 旁注：未定义点

questions.prompt: 为什么 $30^\circ$ 是一个好的检验角？

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: $30^\circ$ 在共同定义域内，且 $\sin30^\circ=1/2$、$\cos30^\circ=\sqrt3/2$、$\cot30^\circ=\sqrt3$ 都有容易计算的精确值；两边均为 $3/4$，无需舍入。

questions.answer: 它是允许角，而且有简单的精确三角比值。

en.prompt: Why is $30^\circ$ a good choice?

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: $30^\circ$ lies in the common domain and has easy exact values: $\sin30^\circ=1/2$, $\cos30^\circ=\sqrt3/2$, and $\cot30^\circ=\sqrt3$. Both sides are exactly $3/4$, with no rounding.

en.answer: It is permissible and has simple exact trigonometric ratios.
en.label: Example 1 sidebar: 30°

questions.label: 例题 1 旁注：30°

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 单位圆坐标为 $(\cos x,\sin x)$，故 $\cos^2x+\sin^2x=1$。把 $\sin^2x$ 移项就得 $\cos^2x=1-\sin^2x$；这是已知恒等式的等价写法。

en.prompt: Why is $1-\sin^2x=\cos^2x$ true?

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: The unit-circle coordinates $(\cos x,\sin x)$ give $\cos^2x+\sin^2x=1$. Rearranging this known identity gives $\cos^2x=1-\sin^2x$.

en.answer: It follows from $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$.
en.label: Example 1 sidebar: Pythagorean identity

questions.label: 例题 1 旁注：勾股恒等式

questions.prompt: (a) 求 $\frac{\tan x\cos x}{\csc x}=1-\cos^2x$ 中 $x$ 的不允许值。(b) 用图形或选一个值验证它可能是恒等式。(c) 证明对所有允许值成立。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: (a) $\tan x$ 要求 $\cos x\ne0$，$\csc x$ 要求 $\sin x\ne0$；$\csc x$ 有定义时本身不为零。因此角度制排除 $x=90^\circ n$，$n\in\mathbb Z$。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: (c) 左边 $=\frac{(\sin x/\cos x)\cos x}{1/\sin x}=\sin^2x$；右边 $1-\cos^2x=\sin^2x$。两个被约去的三角因子在共同定义域内都非零。

questions.answer: 成立，$\sin x\cos x\ne0$（角度制 $x\ne90^\circ n$）。

en.prompt: (a) Determine the non-permissible values in $\frac{\tan x\cos x}{\csc x}=1-\cos^2x$. (b) Verify that it may be an identity graphically or by choosing one value of $x$. (c) Prove it for all permissible values.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (a) $\tan x$ requires $\cos x\ne0$; $\csc x$ requires $\sin x\ne0$ and is never zero when defined. Thus in degrees exclude $x=90^\circ n$, $n\in\mathbb Z$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (b) At $x=30^\circ$, the left side is $[(1/\sqrt3)(\sqrt3/2)]/2=1/4$, and the right side is $1-(\sqrt3/2)^2=1/4$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (c) The left side is $\frac{(\sin x/\cos x)\cos x}{1/\sin x}=\sin^2x$; the right side is $1-\cos^2x=\sin^2x$. The cancelled trigonometric factors are nonzero on the common domain.

en.answer: True on $\sin x\cos x\ne0$ (in degrees $x\ne90^\circ n$).
en.label: Example 1 · Your Turn

questions.label: 例题 2

questions.prompt: 证明 $\frac{\sin2x}{\cos2x+1}=\tan x$ 对所有允许值成立。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: $\cos2x+1=2\cos^2x$，所以共同定义域为 $\cos x\ne0$。

steps.title: 变形与核对

en.prompt: Prove that $\frac{\sin2x}{\cos2x+1}=\tan x$ for all permissible values.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: Since $\cos2x+1=2\cos^2x$, the common domain is $\cos x\ne0$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: The left side is $\frac{2\sin x\cos x}{2\cos^2x}=\frac{\sin x}{\cos x}=\tan x$. Only the nonzero factor $2\cos x$ is cancelled.

en.answer: True on $\cos x\ne0$.
en.label: Example 2 · Your Turn

steps.body: 实折射角还要求 $|(n_1/n_2)\sin\theta_i|\leq1$，以保证被开方数非负。结论是在上述物理条件下成立的改写，不能把 $\sqrt{\cos^2\theta_t}$ 对所有实角都直接写成 $\cos\theta_t$。

exercises.answer: (a) $\sin\theta_t=(n_1/n_2)\sin\theta_i$；(b)、(c) 的公式在非负余弦、实根式和非零分母的物理条件下成立。

en.prompt: When light hits a lens at incidence angle $\theta_i$, some is refracted and some reflected. In the diagram $\theta_r$ is the reflection angle and $\theta_t$ the refraction angle; Fresnel equations describe the behaviour. (a) Snell’s law is $n_1\sin\theta_i=n_2\sin\theta_t$, where $n_1,n_2$ are refractive indices. Isolate $\sin\theta_t$. (b) Under certain conditions, the reflected fraction is $R=\left(\frac{n_1\cos\theta_i-n_2\cos\theta_t}{n_1\cos\theta_i+n_2\cos\theta_t}\right)^2$. Prove this can be written as $R=\left(\frac{n_1\cos\theta_i-n_2\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta_t}}{n_1\cos\theta_i+n_2\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta_t}}\right)^2$. (c) Use (a) to prove $\left(\frac{n_1\cos\theta_i-n_2\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta_t}}{n_1\cos\theta_i+n_2\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta_t}}\right)^2=\left(\frac{n_1\cos\theta_i-n_2\sqrt{1-(n_1/n_2)^2\sin^2\theta_i}}{n_1\cos\theta_i+n_2\sqrt{1-(n_1/n_2)^2\sin^2\theta_i}}\right)^2$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (a) A refractive index satisfies $n_2>0$. Divide by $n_2$ to obtain $\sin\theta_t=\frac{n_1}{n_2}\sin\theta_i$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (b) The Pythagorean identity gives $\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta_t}=\sqrt{\cos^2\theta_t}=|\cos\theta_t|$. The diagram measures the refraction angle from the normal; in the physical range $0\leq\theta_t\leq\pi/2$, $\cos\theta_t\geq0$, so $\cos\theta_t=\sqrt{1-\sin^2\theta_t}$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: Substitute that equality in both the numerator and denominator of the original Fresnel ratio, then square, giving (b). Require $n_1\cos\theta_i+n_2\cos\theta_t\ne0$; for positive indices and $0\leq\theta_i,\theta_t\leq\pi/2$, exclude the endpoint case where both cosines vanish.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (c) Squaring (a) gives $\sin^2\theta_t=(n_1/n_2)^2\sin^2\theta_i$, so $1-\sin^2\theta_t=1-(n_1/n_2)^2\sin^2\theta_i$. Substitute these equal radicands in both radicals in (b), obtaining the required expression.

en.answer: (a) $\sin\theta_t=(n_1/n_2)\sin\theta_i$; (b), (c) hold under the physical conditions of nonnegative cosines, real radicals, and a nonzero denominator.

exercises.prompt: 为什么仅用数值或图形验证两边看似相等，不足以证明方程是恒等式？

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 恒等式要求所有共同允许值都成立。有限表格无法覆盖无限多个实数；有限图窗和分辨率也可能漏掉例外或未定义点。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 例如 $\cos x=\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}$ 在 $x=0$、$\pi/6$ 成立，但 $x=\pi$ 时 $-1\ne1$。成功检验只是证据；任意共同定义域内的代数论证才能构成证明。

exercises.answer: 有限检验不能推出所有允许值成立；需要一般证明。

en.prompt: Why is verifying numerically or graphically that both sides seem equal insufficient to prove an identity?

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: An identity must hold for every commonly permissible value. A finite table cannot cover infinitely many real inputs, and a finite graph window and resolution may miss exceptions or undefined points.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: For example, $\cos x=\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}$ works at $x=0$ and $\pi/6$, but at $x=\pi$ it gives $-1\ne1$. Successful checks are evidence; an algebraic argument valid for every input in the common domain proves an identity.

en.answer: Finite checks cannot establish the statement for all permissible values; a general proof is required.

exercises.prompt: 用余弦差角恒等式证明 $\cos(\pi/2-x)=\sin x$。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 余弦差角公式给 $\cos(\pi/2-x)=\cos(\pi/2)\cos x+\sin(\pi/2)\sin x$。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: 在弧度制中 $\cos(\pi/2)=0$，$\sin(\pi/2)=1$，所以左边 $=0\cos x+1\sin x=\sin x$。所有实数 $x$ 都允许。

exercises.answer: 恒等式对所有实数 $x$ 成立（弧度制）。

en.prompt: Use the cosine difference identity to prove $\cos(\pi/2-x)=\sin x$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: The cosine difference formula gives $\cos(\pi/2-x)=\cos(\pi/2)\cos x+\sin(\pi/2)\sin x$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: In radians, $\cos(\pi/2)=0$ and $\sin(\pi/2)=1$, so the left side is $0\cos x+1\sin x=\sin x$. Every real $x$ is permissible.

en.answer: The identity holds for every real $x$ in radians.

exercises.prompt: 考虑 $\cos x=\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}$。(a) 有哪些不允许值？(b) 给出一个使方程成立的 $x$。(c) 给出一个不成立的 $x$，说明它不是恒等式。(d) 解释恒等式与方程的区别。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: (a) 因 $1-\sin^2x=\cos^2x\geq0$，两边对所有实角都有定义，没有不允许值。注意“无定义”和“等式不成立”是不同情况。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: (c) 取 $x=\pi$（$180^\circ$），左边 $-1$，右边 $\sqrt1=1$，不成立。实质上右边等于 $|\cos x|$，因此原方程仅在 $\cos x\geq0$ 时成立。

steps.title: 变形与核对
steps.body: (d) 方程是两个表达式相等的陈述，解集可只是定义域的一部分；恒等式是对共同定义域所有输入都成立的方程。本式有真值也有反例，故是条件方程而非恒等式。

exercises.answer: (a) 无；(b) $x=0$；(c) $x=\pi$；(d) 恒等式在共同定义域处处成立，一般方程不必如此。

en.prompt: Consider $\cos x=\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}$. (a) What are the non-permissible values? (b) Give a value making the equation true. (c) Give a value that does not work and shows it is not an identity. (d) Explain the difference between an identity and an equation.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (a) Since $1-\sin^2x=\cos^2x\geq0$, both sides are defined for all real angles. There are no non-permissible values. Being undefined differs from failing to satisfy the equation.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (b) At $x=0$, the left side is $1$ and the right side is $\sqrt{1-0}=1$, so it is true.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (c) At $x=\pi$ ($180^\circ$), the left side is $-1$ but the right side is $\sqrt1=1$, so it is false. The right side actually equals $|\cos x|$, so the equation holds exactly when $\cos x\geq0$.

steps.title: Transform and check
steps.body: (d) An equation states that two expressions are equal; its solution set may be only part of its domain. An identity is an equation true for every input in the common domain. This equation has both satisfying values and counterexamples, so it is conditional, not an identity.

en.answer: (a) None; (b) $x=0$; (c) $x=\pi$; (d) an identity holds everywhere in its common domain, whereas a general equation need not.
